findings.effect: The prefix check runs in getTelephonyConnection for every outgoing call, including emergency calls from placeEmergencyConnection, with no emergency exception (TelephonyConnectionService.java:1735-1742, 2153-2186, 2726-2731). When roaming without IMS voice, any dialled string that starts with a listed prefix fails at once with DIALED_CALL_FORWARDING_WHILE_ROAMING.
findings.risk: A value that holds an empty string (startsWith('') is always true) or a prefix that begins an emergency number (for example '1', '9', '11', '99') would make 112/911-type calls fail at once while roaming on CS. So the key is not display-only, even though the values seen so far ('*71','*72') cannot touch an emergency number.

notes: Hold: the key stays in group A, because its check runs on the emergency dial path and a careless prefix would refuse emergency calls while roaming. A cheap guard for future values: proceed when every prefix is non-empty, starts with '*' or '#', and neither is a leading part of nor starts with a WPS prefix ('*272', '*31#*272', '#31#*272'); read by hand otherwise.
